title: Hess's law
caption: The enthalpy change depends only on the start and finish, not the route. Burning carbon straight to CO₂ releases 394 kJ mol⁻¹; going via CO (−111, then −283) gives the same total.
alt: Hess triangle: C + O₂ top left, CO₂ top right, CO + ½O₂ at the bottom; direct route −394, indirect route −111 then −283.
description: Direct: C + O₂ → CO₂, ΔH = −394 kJ mol⁻¹.
Indirect: C + ½O₂ → CO, −111; then CO + ½O₂ → CO₂, −283.
